summary: Sanity check after Railway deploy config files were added (no app code touched). Config files validated (JSON+TOML parse OK, Procfile format OK, package.json has serve dep and start:prod script). Backend endpoints still healthy: GET /api/business 200, GET /api/services 200 with 6 services, POST /api/auth/login 200 returning {token,user}. Frontend at 390x844 renders Home (hero + RESERVAR CITA + 3 floating buttons WhatsApp/Reviews/Phone, no Instagram) and /reservar step 1 shows 3-col grid with all 6 services. No regressions.

config_validation.backend/nixpacks.toml: valid TOML, python311 + pip install requirements
config_validation.frontend/nixpacks.toml: valid TOML, nodejs-20_x + yarn build; [start] cmd = yarn start:prod
config_validation.README.md: present with Railway deploy instructions for both services

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: frontend/nixpacks.toml uses `yarn start:prod` and Procfile matches, but railway.json startCommand is `serve -s build -l $PORT` directly. Both work; consistency-wise you could align them (either both call `yarn start:prod` or both call serve directly).
Minor: README suggests CORS_ORIGINS=<frontend-url> as single value; ensure backend parses comma-separated list if multiple domains later needed.

Minor: frontend/Procfile uses $PORT via shell, and yarn passes it to `serve -l $PORT` - `serve` v14 accepts $PORT literal only when the shell expands it (Procfile is executed in a shell so this is fine). No action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 was a lightweight sanity check post Railway config addition. No code changes. All 6 services, admin login, and mobile UI (Home + /reservar step-1 3-col grid) verified. Actual Railway deploy cannot be tested from this environment.
